description: This file defines the ProfilerNodeVisitor class in the Twig template engine, implementing node visiting logic for profiling template rendering. It instruments nodes like modules, blocks, and macros with profiling start and end nodes.

classes.name: ProfilerNodeVisitor
classes.description: A class implementing Twig's NodeVisitorInterface to inject profiling nodes into template nodes during traversing, enabling profiling of template rendering in Twig.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes ProfilerNodeVisitor with an extension name, generates a variable name for profiling.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Returns the node unchanged; placeholder for pre-processing logic.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Injects profiling nodes into ModuleNode, BlockNode, and MacroNode instances for profiling start and stop points.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the visitor (0), used to determine traversal order.
